items.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025
items.q: There were Seldon Powell — I just remember so many of them that were on these sessions

ctx.x: Yup. I think so. There were Seldon Powell — I just remember so many of them that were on these sessions because they were in New York now and they could read and they, you know, because on a record date it was three hours and you could do four sides and you usually did three or four. And you know they were all good musicians and had a good time being there. And their scale was their scale, which was the union scale for — I mean I know singers were like 60 bucks for a record session, and it did go up and up you…
What’s the state of the musicians union now? Are you aware of it?
